`omni --runner` flags;\nVSCode gains bearer wiring here.\n\n**M5 — Concurrent multi-runner UI (web/PWA)**\nRunnerRegistry persistence (+ migration/recovery); `RunnerConnection` scoping\nand all-profile lifecycle/retry; switcher adapted from shadcn `sidebar-07`;\nURL+password onboarding adapted from `login-03`; status states; drafts keyed\nper identity; session administration + runner-name controls; inactive-runner\nnotifications; two-runner Playwright +\ncross-origin browser specs pass. Switcher controls stay hidden in Electron\nuntil M6.\n\n**M6 — Electron + VSCode remote clients**\nMain-process networking + IPC RuntimeAPIs; `safeStorage` tokens; co-location\ncapability gating for native pickers/editor links; switcher enabled in\nElectron; VSCode `SecretStorage`; all-profile native notifications;\n`tests/electron` and `tests/vscode` updated.\n\n**M7 — Capacitor iOS + Android**\n`apps/mobile` Capacitor project; iOS and Android native projects; native\n`RuntimeAPIs` networking/SSE bridge; Keychain/Keystore credential adapter;\nexternal-link and local-notification capabilities; safe-area/mobile layout\nverification; build/sync smoke checks and packaged mobile acceptance.\n\nEach milestone leaves all already-shipped shells working; M1–M3 are guarded by\nparity tests, M4 ships dark, M5 turns concurrent multi-runner on for web/PWA,\nM6 completes desktop/VSCode, and M7 completes the approved native platforms.\n\n## 9. Risks & trust surfaces\n\n# Interface / Runner / Platform Apps Implementation Plan\n\n> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use ultrapowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.\n\n**Goal:** Ship OmniHarness as one logical headless runner plus one shared interface delivered through web/PWA, Electron desktop, Capacitor iOS/Android, and VSCode, with every authenticated runner profile concurrently connected while the client process is active.\n\n**Architecture:** Keep the repository as one pnpm package with enforced runner/shared/interface boundaries. The runner remains a managed API-server + local ACP-bridge deployment; clients use transport-neutral `RuntimeAPIs` over HTTP/SSE or validated native bridges. The existing shared password creates revocable cookie or bearer sessions, while browser-to-browser authorization uses a same-runner S256 PKCE approval window rather than open-CORS password login.\n\n**Tech Stack:** Node 22+, TypeScript, React 19, Vite, TanStack Query, Base UI/shadcn, SQLite/Drizzle, HTTP/SSE, Electron, Capacitor iOS/Android, Swift Keychain Services, Android Keystore, VSCode extension APIs, Vitest, Playwright.\n\n**North Star Product:** One interface installed anywhere, keeping all of a builder's runners visible and connected, with platform-native security and capabilities but one shared product experience.\n\n**Current Milestone:** Deliver the entire approved v1 in the seven architecture milestones below; this plan does not stop after the runner or web split.\n\n**Future Product Direction:** Merged cross-runner dashboards, native push after mobile suspension, runner-to-runner handoff, and later package extraction remain context only.\n\n**Final Functionality Standard:** Completion requires real runner, browser, Electron, VSCode, iOS, and Android functionality; password authentication and session administration; concurrent live runner streams; restart/resync safety; platform-secure credential storage; end-to-end migration/recovery states; and the full verification matrix. No mock shell, placeholder connection, canned runner data, or fake native bridge can satisfy a task.\n\n---\n\n## Approved product decisions\n\n- One logical runner deployment owns SQLite, supervisor, agents, ACP bridge, PTYs, auth, and events. The API server and bridge remain separate co-located processes.\n- Desktop uses Electron. iOS and Android use Capacitor. Web/PWA and VSCode remain first-class.\n- Every saved authenticated runner keeps one main event connection live while the app process is active. The interface renders one runner workspace at a time.\n- The existing shared runner password is the only login secret. It creates separate revocable sessions; clients do not persist the password.\n- Browser/PWA cross-origin login uses a target-runner approval window + S256 PKCE. Native hosts use originless direct password login and never expose bearer tokens to renderers/WebViews.\n- Work stays in the current checkout. Do not create a branch or worktree. Preserve all existing user changes.\n\n## Product and state model\n\n### Primary journeys\n\n1. Start a headless runner and use it through API/SSE, with or without a static interface artifact.\n2. Add runners from web/PWA through the target-runner authorization window.\n3. Add runners from Electron, Capacitor, VSCode, or CLI with URL + shared password.\n4. Keep all authenticated profiles connected, switch the visible workspace without closing inactive main streams, and receive runner-named notifications.\n5. Return after restart with profiles, per-runner drafts, cursors, and preferences restored.\n6. Recover honestly from offline, deferred, needs-reauth, TLS-untrusted, identity-mismatch, incompatible, degraded/resync, and runner-stopping states.\n7. List/revoke sessions, rotate the shared password, forget/edit profiles, rename a runner, and migrate existing Electron state.\n\n### Ownership and invariants\n\n- Runner owns all domain state. Client persistence is limited to profiles, credentials through a platform adapter, UI preferences, bounded preview caches, cursors, and drafts.\n- `runnerInstanceId` is the durable scope after identity is known; profile UUID is only the pre-login/list-key fallback.\n- Every async response, mutation, timer, reconnect, snapshot, and frame carries/checks runner scope before updating a Manager or Query cache.\n- Bootstrap/snapshot proves authority and completeness. Preview caches never satisfy a fresh-load gate.\n- SSE ids are `<streamEpoch>:<sequence>`. Every event frame carries an id. Resync has a stable reason and a separate anti-storm governor.\n- One profile has one main event stream. Terminal streams exist only for the visible runner and reload bounded scrollback on activation.\n- Query keys, drafts, cursors, worker caches, notifications, and errors are runner-scoped.\n- Every server decision/refusal/failure emits a typed named event; user-relevant server failures additionally emit `error.surfaced`.\n- All new user-facing copy is added to every file in `shared/locales/*.json` and rendered with `t()`.\n- Shared Manager subscriptions remain narrow; draft text, cursors, hover/open state, and other high-churn fields cannot repaint the full application shell.\n\n## File map\n\n### Create\n\n- `src/shared/runtime.ts` — runtime surface/stop/event-id primitives shared across boundaries.\n- `src/shared/bootstrap.ts` — runner identity, capabilities, bootstrap, and compatibility payload types.\n- `src/shared/home-types.ts` — portable on-wire home/event/settings/session records with an interface re-export shim.\n- `src/shared/api-revision.ts` — revision window, capability ids, and declared contract-change classifications.\n- `src/shared/worker-entries.ts` — client/server worker-entry types.\n- `src/shared/planning-review.ts` — planning review schemas/types safe for the interface.\n- `src/shared/worker-types.ts` — supported worker types and display labels used by both sides.\n- `tsconfig.shared.json`, `tsconfig.runner.json`, `tsconfig.interface.json` — independent typecheck projects.\n- `src/server/runner/config.ts` — isolated runner/bridge/gateway/static/TLS configuration.\n- `src/server/runner/ManagedBridgeController.ts` — bridge adopt/start/retry/ownership state machine.\n- `src/server/runner/RunnerReadinessManager.ts` — bounded in-memory readiness/bridge/static state.\n- `src/server/runner/shutdown.ts` — ordered server/SSE/PTY/gateway/bridge shutdown.\n- `scripts/runner.ts` — production/development runner entry.\n- `src/runtime/http/stream-response.ts` — bounded Web-stream to Node response bridge.\n- `src/runtime/http/static-files.ts` — safe SPA/static serving, cache policy, manifest validation.\n- `src/runtime/http/bootstrap-html.ts` — escaped bootstrap injection.\n- `src/runtime/http/security-headers.ts` — web and packaged CSP/referrer headers.\n- `apps/interface/index.html`, `apps/interface/app-shell.html`, `apps/interface/vite.config.ts`, `apps/interface/src/main.tsx` — Vite interface target.\n- `src/interface/providers.tsx`, `src/interface/styles/**` — Vite-owned providers and styles moved from `src/app`.\n- `apps/interface/vite-csp-manifest.ts` — build-time theme hash/asset manifest output.\n- `apps/interface/public/manifest.webmanifest`, `apps/interface/public/sw.js` — Vite-owned PWA assets.\n- `src/runtime-api/stream.ts` — transport-neutral stream/frame contract.\n- `src/runtime-api/request.ts` — redirect-safe request/error primitives.\n- `src/runtime-api/domains/*.ts` — typed API domain adapters for auth, runs, conversations, workers, files, git, planning, settings, accounts, notifications, and terminals.\n- `src/server/auth/browser-authorization.ts` — S256 approval-code lifecycle.\n- `src/server/auth/stream-tickets.ts` — atomic single-use path-bound SSE tickets.\n- `src/server/auth/trusted-proxy.ts` — socket-derived protocol/client identity.\n- `src/server/auth/cors.ts` — route-aware bearer CORS with no credentials flag.\n- `src/runtime/http/routes/auth-browser-authorization.ts` — authorization/code-exchange routes.\n- `src/runtime/http/routes/auth-stream-ticket.ts` — ticket route.\n- `src/runtime/http/routes/auth-sessions.ts` — session list/revoke routes.\n- `src/interface/auth/InterfaceAuthorizationScreen.tsx` — same-runner origin approval screen.\n- `src/interface/runners/RunnerProfile.ts` — versioned profile and status types.\n- `src/interface/runners/RunnerCredentialStore.ts` — platform credential-store interface.\n- `src/interface/runners/RunnerProfileStore.ts` — platform profile/prefs persistence interface.\n- `src/interface/runners/RunnerConnection.ts` — one runner's transport, managers, caches, state machine, cursor, retries.\n- `src/interface/runners/RunnerRegistry.ts` — all profiles/connections + active selection.\n- `src/interface/runners/RunnerRegistryProvider.tsx` — narrow active/all-runner React subscriptions.\n- `src/interface/runners/RunnerSwitcher.tsx` — shadcn `sidebar-07`-derived switcher.\n- `src/interface/runners/ConnectRunnerScreen.tsx` — shadcn `login-03`-derived onboarding.\n- `src/interface/runners/RunnerSessionsPanel.tsx` — compact session/revocation control surface.\n- `src/interface/home/mutations/*.ts` — split `apps/electron/src/ProfileStore.ts`, `CredentialStore.ts`, `RuntimeBridge.ts`, `TlsPinStore.ts`, `migration.ts` — remote-only desktop host.\n- `src/runtime-api/capacitor.ts` — Capacitor bridge-backed Bearer login\n   returns one opaque session token in the response body. The password is\n   verified once and is never persisted by a client; every device/profile gets\n   a separately revocable session row.\n\n   Guards accept `Authorization: Bearer <token>`; same-origin enforcement is\n   skipped for bearer requests because the credential is not ambient. +export const RUNNER_PACKAGE_VERSION = "0.1.0";
+
+export const RUNNER_API_REVISION = {
+  minimum: 1,
+  current: 1,
+} as const;
+
+export const RUNNER_CAPABILITIES = [
+  "unified_worker_stream",
+] as const;
+
+export type RunnerCapabilityId = typeof RUNNER_CAPABILITIES[number];
+
+export type ApiRevisionWindow = {
+  minimum: number;
+  current: number;
+};
+
+export type ApiCompatibilityResult = {
+  compatible: boolean;
+  reason: "revision_window_mismatch" | null;
+  unknownCapabilities: string[];
+};
+
+export type ApiContractChangeClassification =
+  | "additive-capability"
+  | "transport-breaking";
+
+export const ROUTE_CONTRACT_DECLARATION = {
+  fixtureSchemaVersion: 1,
+  fingerprint: "fnv1a32:3e6594ed",
+  classification: "transport-breaking",
+  apiRevision: 1,
+} as const;
+
+const KNOWN_CAPABILITIES = new Set<string>(RUNNER_CAPABILITIES);
+
+export function stableRouteContractFingerprint(routes: readonly string[]) {
+  let hash = 2_166_136_261;
+  for (const character of [...routes].sort().join("\n")) {
+    hash ^= character.charCodeAt(0);
+    hash = Math.imul(hash, 16_777_619);
+  }
+  return `fnv1a32:${(hash >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(8, "0")}`;
+}
+
+export function assessApiCompatibility(remote: {
+  apiRevision: ApiRevisionWindow;
+  capabilities: readonly string[];
+}): ApiCompatibilityResult {
+  const windowsOverlap = (
+    remote.apiRevision.minimum <= RUNNER_API_REVISION.current
+    && RUNNER_API_REVISION.minimum <= remote.apiRevision.current
+  );
+  return {
+    compatible: windowsOverlap,
+    reason: windowsOverlap ? null : "revision_window_mismatch",
+    unknownCapabilities: remote.capabilities.filter(
+      (capability) => !KNOWN_CAPABILITIES.has(capability),
+    ),
+  };
+}
+
+export function validateApiContractChange(change: {
+  classification: ApiContractChangeClassification;
+  capability?: string;
+  previousRevision: number;
+  nextRevision: number;
+}): { valid: boolean; reason: string | null } {

+import { randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
+import { eq } from "drizzle-orm";
+import { db } from "@/server/db";

+import {

+  RUNNER_CAPABILITIES,
+  RUNNER_PACKAGE_VERSION,
+} from "@/shared/api-revision";
+import { getEventStreamEpoch } from "@/server/events/named-events";
+import type {
+  RunnerBootstrapIdentity,
+  RunnerReadinessState,
+} from "@/shared/bootstrap";
+
+const RUNNER_IDENTITY_SETTING_KEY = "__runner_identity_v1";
+const DEFAULT_RUNNER_NAME = "OmniHarness Runner";
+
+export type StoredRunnerIdentity = {
+  runnerInstanceId: string;
+  name: string;
+};
+
+export interface RunnerIdentityStore {
+  read(): Promise<string | null>;
+  writeIfAbsent(value: string): Promise<void>;
+}
+
+type ReadinessSnapshot = {
+  status: RunnerReadinessState;
+  bridgeStatus: string;
+};
+
+type ReadinessSource = {
+  getSnapshot(): ReadinessSnapshot;
+};
+
+let readinessSource: ReadinessSource | null = null;
+
+const databaseIdentityStore: RunnerIdentityStore = {
+  async read() {
+    const row = await db.select({ value: settings.value })
+      .from(settings)
+      .where(eq(settings.key, RUNNER_IDENTITY_SETTING_KEY))
+      .get();
+    return row?.value ?? null;
+  },
+  async writeIfAbsent(value) {
+    const now = new Date();
+    await db.insert(settings).values({
+      key: RUNNER_IDENTITY_SETTING_KEY,
+      value,
+      updatedAt: now,
+    }).onConflictDoNothing();
+  },
+};
+
+function parseStoredIdentity(value: string | null): StoredRunnerIdentity | null {
+  if (!value) {
+    return null;
+  }
+  try {
+    const parsed = JSON.parse(value) as Partial<StoredRunnerIdentity>;
+    if (
+      typeof parsed.runnerInstanceId !== "string"
+      || !parsed.runnerInstanceId.trim()
+      || typeof parsed.name !== "string"
+      || !parsed.name.trim()
+    ) {
+      return null;
+    }
+    return {
+      runnerInstanceId: parsed.runnerInstanceId,
+      name: parsed.name,
+    };
+  } catch {
+    return null;
+  }
+}
+
+export async function ensureRunnerIdentity(
+  store: RunnerIdentityStore = databaseIdentityStore,
+): Promise<StoredRunnerIdentity> {
+  const existing = parseStoredIdentity(await store.read());
+  if (existing) {
+    return existing;
+  }
+
+  const candidate: StoredRunnerIdentity = {
+    runnerInstanceId: randomUUID(),
+    name: DEFAULT_RUNNER_NAME,
+  };
+  await store.writeIfAbsent(JSON.stringify(candidate));
+  return parseStoredIdentity(await store.read()) ?? candidate;
+}
+
+export function configureRunnerReadinessSource(source: ReadinessSource | null) {
+  readinessSource = source;
+}
+
+export async function buildRunnerBootstrapIdentity(): Promise<RunnerBootstrapIdentity> {
+  const identity = await ensureRunnerIdentity();
+  const readiness = readinessSource?.getSnapshot() ?? {
+    status: "starting",
+    bridgeStatus: "unavailable",
+  };
+  return {
+    ...identity,
+    version: RUNNER_PACKAGE_VERSION,
+    apiRevision: { ...RUNNER_API_REVISION },
+    capabilities: [...RUNNER_CAPABILITIES],
+    bridgeState: readiness.bridgeStatus === "ready" ? "ready" : "degraded",
+    readinessState: readiness.status,
+    streamEpoch: getEventStreamEpoch(),
+  };
+}

+import { isIP } from "node:net";
+
+export type RequestNetworkIdentity = {
+  clientAddress: string;
+  protocol: "http" | "https";
+  forwarded: boolean;
+  publicOrigin?: string;
+};
+
+type ResolveRequestNetworkIdentityArgs = {
+  url: string;
+  headers: Headers;
+  socketAddress: string | null;
+  socketEncrypted: boolean;
+  trustedProxyRules?: readonly string[];
+};
+
+const requestNetworkIdentities = new WeakMap<Request, RequestNetworkIdentity>();
+
+function normalizeAddress(value: string | null | undefined) {
+  const trimmed = value?.trim() ?? "";
+  if (trimmed.startsWith("::ffff:")) {
+    return trimmed.slice("::ffff:".length);
+  }
+  return trimmed || "unknown";
+}
+
+function ipv4Number(address: string) {
+  if (isIP(address) !== 4) {
+    return null;
+  }
+  return address.split(".").reduce(
+    (value, part) => ((value << 8) | Number(part)) >>> 0,
+    0,
+  );
+}
+
+function matchesRule(address: string, rule: string) {
+  const normalizedRule = normalizeAddress(rule);
+  if (!normalizedRule.includes("/")) {
+    return address === normalizedRule;
+  }
+  const [network, rawPrefix] = normalizedRule.split("/", 2);
+  const addressNumber = ipv4Number(address);
+  const networkNumber = ipv4Number(network ?? "");
+  const prefix = Number(rawPrefix);
+  if (
+    addressNumber === null
+    || networkNumber === null
+    || !Number.isInteger(prefix)
+    || prefix < 0
+    || prefix > 32
+  ) {
+    return false;
+  }
+  const mask = prefix === 0 ? 0 : (0xffffffff << (32 - prefix)) >>> 0;
+  return (addressNumber & mask) === (networkNumber & mask);
+}
+
+function firstForwardedValue(value: string | null, key: "for" | "proto") {
+  const first = value?.split(",")[0] ?? "";
+  const match = first.match(new RegExp(`(?:^|;)\\s*${key}=("[^"]+"|[^;\\s]+)`, "i"));
+  return match?.[1]?.replace(/^"|"$/g, "") ?? null;
+}
+
+function firstHeaderValue(value: string | null) {
+  return value?.split(",")[0]?.trim() || null;
+}
+
+export function configuredTrustedProxyRules() {
+  return (process.env.OMNIHARNESS_TRUSTED_PROXIES ?? "")
+    .split(",")
+    .map((value) => value.trim())
+    .filter(Boolean);
+}
+
+export function resolveRequestNetworkIdentity({
+  url,
+  headers,
+  socketAddress,
+  socketEncrypted,
+  trustedProxyRules = configuredTrustedProxyRules(),
+}: ResolveRequestNetworkIdentityArgs): RequestNetworkIdentity {
+  const requestUrl = new URL(url);
+  const peerAddress = normalizeAddress(socketAddress ?? requestUrl.hostname);
+  const trusted = trustedProxyRules.some((rule) => matchesRule(peerAddress, rule));
+  const forwarded = headers.get("forwarded");
+  const forwardedAddress = firstForwardedValue(forwarded, "for")
+    ?? firstHeaderValue(headers.get("x-forwarded-for"));
+  const forwardedProtocol = firstForwardedValue(forwarded, "proto")
+    ?? firstHeaderValue(headers.get("x-forwarded-proto"));
+  const forwardedHost = firstHeaderValue(headers.get("x-forwarded-host"));
+  const protocol = trusted && forwardedProtocol === "https"
+    ? "https"
+    : socketEncrypted
+      ? "https"
+      : "http";
+  const host = trusted && forwardedHost
+    ? forwardedHost
+    : headers.get("host")?.trim() || requestUrl.host;
+
+  return {
+    clientAddress: trusted && forwardedAddress
+      ? normalizeAddress(forwardedAddress.replace(/^\[|\]$/g, ""))
+      : peerAddress,
+    protocol,
+    forwarded: trusted && Boolean(forwardedAddress || forwardedProtocol || forwardedHost),
+    publicOrigin: `${protocol}://${host}`,
+  };
+}
+
+export function associateRequestNetworkIdentity(
+  request: Request,
+  identity: RequestNetworkIdentity,
+) {
+  requestNetworkIdentities.set(request, identity);
+}
+
+export function getRequestNetworkIdentity(request: Request) {
+  return requestNetworkIdentities.get(request) ?? resolveRequestNetworkIdentity({
+    url: request.url,
+    headers: request.headers,
+    socketAddress: new URL(request.url).hostname,
+    socketEncrypted: new URL(request.url).protocol === "https:",
+  });
+}
+
+export function isLoopbackAddress(address: string) {
+  const normalized = normalizeAddress(address);
+  return normalized === "127.0.0.1"
+    || normalized === "::1"
+    || normalized === "localhost";
+}
+
+export function isSecureOrLoopbackRequest(identity: RequestNetworkIdentity) {
+  return identity.protocol === "https" || isLoopbackAddress(identity.clientAddress);
+}
+
+export function hasBrowserProvenanceHeaders(request: Request) {
+  if (request.headers.has("origin") || request.headers.has("referer")) {

+  }
+  for (const key of request.headers.keys()) {
+    if (key.toLowerCase().startsWith("sec-fetch-")) {

+    }
+  }

+const ALLOWED_REQUEST_HEADERS = new Set(["authorization", "content-type"]);

+function bearerToken(request: Request) {

+
+function appendVary(headers: Headers, value: string) {
+  const values = new Set(
+    (headers.get("vary") ?? "").split(",").map((entry) => entry.trim()).filter(Boolean),
+  );
+  values.add(value);
+  headers.set("vary", [...values].join(", "));

+async function hasActiveBrowserOrigin(origin: string) {

+    .from(authSessions)
+    .where(and(
+      eq(authSessions.transport, "bearer"),
+      eq(authSessions.clientKind, "browser"),
+      eq(authSessions.boundOrigin, origin),
+      isNull(authSessions.revokedAt),
+      gt(authSessions.expiresAt, new Date()),
+      gt(authSessions.absoluteExpiresAt, new Date()),
+    ))
+    .limit(1);
+  return rows.length > 0;

+export type NativeTlsPolicyInput = {
+  standardTrust: "trusted" | "untrusted";
+  presentedSpki: string;
+  storedSpki: string | null;
+};
+
+export type NativeTlsPolicyDecision =
+  | {
+      decision: "allow-standard";
+      requiresConfirmation: false;
+    }
+  | {
+      decision: "allow-pinned";
+      requiresConfirmation: false;
+      presentedSpki: string;
+    }
+  | {
+      decision: "confirm-pin";
+      requiresConfirmation: true;
+      presentedSpki: string;
+    }
+  | {
+      decision: "pin-mismatch";
+      requiresConfirmation: true;
+      presentedSpki: string;
+      storedSpki: string;
+    };
+
+export function resolveNativeTlsPolicy(
+  input: NativeTlsPolicyInput,
+): NativeTlsPolicyDecision {
+  if (input.standardTrust === "trusted") {
+    return {
+      decision: "allow-standard",
+      requiresConfirmation: false,
+    };
+  }
+  if (!input.storedSpki) {
+    return {
+      decision: "confirm-pin",
+      requiresConfirmation: true,
+      presentedSpki: input.presentedSpki,
+    };
+  }
+  if (input.storedSpki === input.presentedSpki) {
+    return {
+      decision: "allow-pinned",
+      requiresConfirmation: false,
+      presentedSpki: input.presentedSpki,
+    };
+  }
+  return {
+    decision: "pin-mismatch",
+    requiresConfirmation: true,
+    presentedSpki: input.presentedSpki,
+    storedSpki: input.storedSpki,
+  };
+}

## Codex progress · 2026-07-31T01:52:09.292Z

The new authentication rules now pass focused tests: native bearer login is originless, cookie and bearer credentials cannot be swapped, browser bearer sessions are origin-bound, CORS is route-driven with no credentials flag, proxy headers are ignored unless the socket peer is trusted, and native TLS pinning only activates after normal trust fails. I’m tightening the shared login audit path and plaintext refusal before closing this task.

+export type PasswordLoginAttemptResult =
+  | {
+      ok: true;
+      ipAddress: string;
+      userAgent: string | null;
+    }
+  | {
+      ok: false;
+      status: 401 | 429;
+      message: string;

+export async function verifyPasswordLoginAttempt(args: {
+  request: Request;
+  password: string;
+  purpose: "password_login" | "browser_authorization";
+}): Promise<PasswordLoginAttemptResult> {
+  const networkIdentity = getRequestNetworkIdentity(args.request);

+    await insertAuthEvent({
+      eventType: "auth.login_rate_limited",

+        ipAddress,
+        userAgent,
+        purpose: args.purpose,
+        retryAfterSeconds: rateLimitStatus.retryAfterSeconds,
+      },
+    });

+      ok: false,
+      status: 429,
+      message: "Too many login attempts. Try again later.",

+import { StateManager } from "@/lib/state-manager";
+
+type AuthorizationStatus =
+  | "idle"
+  | "opening"
+  | "waiting"
+  | "exchanging"
+  | "authorized"
+  | "popup-blocked"
+  | "denied"
+  | "timed-out"
+  | "failed";
+
+type BrowserAuthorizationSnapshot = {
+  status: AuthorizationStatus;
+  state: string | null;
+  error: string | null;
+};
+
+type MessageEventLike = {
+  origin: string;
+  source: unknown;
+  data: unknown;
+};
+
+export interface BrowserAuthorizationWindowAdapter {
+  origin: string;
+  open(url: string, target: string, features: string): unknown | null;
+  addMessageListener(listener: (event: MessageEventLike) => void): () => void;
+  setTimer(callback: () => void, timeoutMs: number): unknown;
+  clearTimer(timer: unknown): void;
+}
+
+function randomBase64Url(byteLength = 32) {
+  const bytes = new Uint8Array(byteLength);
+  globalThis.crypto.getRandomValues(bytes);
+  let binary = "";
+  for (const value of bytes) {
+    binary += String.fromCharCode(value);
+  }
+  return btoa(binary)
+    .replaceAll("+", "-")
+    .replaceAll("/", "_")
+    .replace(/=+$/, "");
+}
+
+async function createChallenge(verifier: string) {
+  const digest = await globalThis.crypto.subtle.digest(
+    "SHA-256",
+    new TextEncoder().encode(verifier),
+  );
+  let binary = "";
+  for (const value of new Uint8Array(digest)) {
+    binary += String.fromCharCode(value);
+  }
+  return btoa(binary)
+    .replaceAll("+", "-")
+    .replaceAll("/", "_")
+    .replace(/=+$/, "");
+}
+
+export class BrowserAuthorizationManager extends StateManager<BrowserAuthorizationSnapshot> {
+  private cancelListener: (() => void) | null = null;
+  private timer: unknown = null;
+  private rejectPending: ((error: Error) => void) | null = null;
+
+  constructor(private readonly windowAdapter: BrowserAuthorizationWindowAdapter) {
+    super({ status: "idle", state: null, error: null });
+  }
+
+  async authorize<T>(args: {
+    runnerUrl: string;
+    exchange(input: {
+      code: string;
+      verifier: string;
+      state: string;
+      origin: string;
+    }): Promise<T>;
+  }): Promise<T> {
+    this.cleanup();
+    const runnerOrigin = new URL(args.runnerUrl).origin;
+    const verifier = randomBase64Url();
+    const state = randomBase64Url();
+    this.update(() => ({ status: "opening", state, error: null }));
+    const challenge = await createChallenge(verifier);
+    const authorizeUrl = new URL("/authorize-interface", runnerOrigin);
+    authorizeUrl.searchParams.set("origin", this.windowAdapter.origin);
+    authorizeUrl.searchParams.set("state", state);
+    authorizeUrl.searchParams.set("challenge", challenge);
+    authorizeUrl.searchParams.set("method", "S256");
+    const popup = this.windowAdapter.open(
+      authorizeUrl.toString(),
+      "omniharness-authorize",
+      "popup,width=480,height=720",
+    );
+    if (!popup) {
+      this.update(() => ({
+        status: "popup-blocked",
+        state,
+        error: "Authorization popup was blocked.",
+      }));
+      throw new Error("Authorization popup was blocked.");
+    }
+
+    this.update(() => ({ status: "waiting", state, error: null }));
+    return new Promise<T>((resolve, reject) => {
+      this.rejectPending = reject;
+      this.cancelListener = this.windowAdapter.addMessageListener((event) => {
+        const data = event.data as {
+          type?: unknown;
+          code?: unknown;
+          state?: unknown;
+          denied?: unknown;
+        } | null;
+        if (
+          event.source !== popup
+          || event.origin !== runnerOrigin
+          || !data

+          || data.state !== state

+        }

+          this.markDenied();
+          return;
+        }
+        if (typeof data.code !== "string") {
+          return;
+        }
+        this.update(() => ({ status: "exchanging", state, error: null }));
+        void args.exchange({
+          code: data.code,
+          verifier,
+          state,
+          origin: this.windowAdapter.origin,
+        }).then((result) => {
+          this.cleanup();
+          this.update(() => ({ status: "authorized", state, error: null }));
+          resolve(result);
+        }, (error: unknown) => {
+          this.cleanup();
+          const normalized = error instanceof Error ? error : new Error(String(error));
+          this.update(() => ({ status: "failed", state, error: normalized.message }));

+  markDenied() {

+  }
+
+  markTimedOut() {
+    const reject = this.rejectPending;
+    this.cleanup();
+    this.update((current) => ({
+      status: "timed-out",
+      state: current.state,
+      error: "Authorization timed out.",
+    }));

+  }

+    const params = new URLSearchParams(input);
+    return `omniharness://authorize?${params.toString()}`;
+  }

+    this.cancelListener = null;

+    }
+    this.rejectPending = null;
+  }

+function ticketHash(ticket: string) {

+export class StreamTicketManager {
+  private readonly records = new Map<string, StreamTicketRecord>();

+  constructor(options: {

+  } = {}) {

+    if (!STREAM_TICKET_PATTERN.test(ticket)) {
+      throw new TypeError("Stream ticket must be 43–128 base64url characters.");
+    }
+    const expiresAt = this.now() + STREAM_TICKET_TTL_MS;
+    this.records.set(ticketHash(ticket), {
+      sessionId: input.sessionId,
+      path,
+      origin: input.origin,
+      expiresAt,
+    });
+    return {

+    };
+  }

+  async redeem(input: { ticket: string; path: string; origin: string }) {
+    if (!STREAM_TICKET_PATTERN.test(input.ticket)) {
+      throw new Error("Stream ticket is invalid or already used.");
+    }
+    const key = ticketHash(input.ticket);
+    const record = this.records.get(key);
+    this.records.delete(key);
+    if (!record) {
+      throw new Error("Stream ticket is invalid or already used.");
+    }
+    if (record.expiresAt <= this.now()) {
+      throw new Error("Stream ticket expired.");
+    }
+    const path = validateStreamTicketPath(input.path);
+    if (record.path !== path) {

+    }

+      || session.transport !== "bearer"
+      || session.clientKind !== "browser"
+      || session.boundOrigin !== record.origin
+    ) {

+    }
+    return { session, origin: record.origin };
+  }

+    this.records.clear();
+  }

WritableStreamLike = Pick<NodeJS.WritableStream, \"write\">;\n\ninterface OmniCliIo {\n  stdout: WritableStreamLike;\n  stderr: WritableStreamLike;\n}\n\ninterface WatchState {\n  messageIds: Set<string>;\n  eventIds: Set<string>;\n  workerTextById: Map<string, string>;\n  printedTerminal: boolean;\n}\n\nfunction writeLine(stream: WritableStreamLike, line = \"\") {\n  stream.write(`${line}\\n`);\n}\n\nfunction describeExecutionEvent(details: string | null, fallback: string) {\n  if (!details?.trim()) {\n    return fallback;\n  }\n\n  try {\n    const parsed = JSON.parse(details) as Record<string, unknown>;\n    for (const key of [\"summary\", \"reason\", \"error\"]) {\n      const value = parsed[key];\n      if (typeof value === \"string\" && value.trim()) {\n        return value.trim();\n      }\n    }\n  } catch {\n    return details.trim();\n  }\n\n  return fallback;\n}\n\nfunction displayWorkerText(worker: typeof workers.$inferSelect, agent: AgentRecord | null) {\n  return (\n    agent?.renderedOutput?.trim()\n    || agent?.currentText?.trim()\n    || agent?.lastText?.trim()\n    || worker.currentText.trim()\n    || worker.lastText.trim()\n    || worker.outputLog.trim()\n  );\n}\n\nasync function buildWorkerAgentMap(workerRecords: Array<typeof workers.$inferSelect>) {\n  const entries = await Promise.all(\n    workerRecords.map(async (worker) => {\n      const agent = await getAgent(worker.id).catch(() => null);\n      return [worker.id, agent] as const;\n    }),\n  );\n  return new Map(entries);\n}\n\nasync function printRunUpdates(runId: string, state: WatchState, io: OmniCliIo) {\n  const [run, runMessages, runWorkers, runEvents] = await Promise.all([\n    db.select().from(runs).where(eq(runs.id, runId)).get(),\n    db.select().from(messages).where(eq(messages.runId, runId)).orderBy(asc(messages.createdAt), asc(messages.id)),\n    db.select().from(workers).where(eq(workers.runId, runId)).orderBy(asc(workers.createdAt), asc(workers.id)),\n    listExecutionEventsForRun(runId),\n  ]);\n  const agentByWorkerId = await buildWorkerAgentMap(runWorkers);\n\n  for (const message of runMessages) {\n    if (state.messageIds.has(message.id)) {\n      continue;\n    }\n    state.messageIds.add(message.id);\n    const workerLabel = message.workerId ? `:${message.workerId}` : \"\";\n    writeLine(io.stdout, `[message:${message.role}${workerLabel}] ${message.content}`);\n  }\n\n  for (const event of runEvents) {\n    if (state.eventIds.has(event.id)) {\n      continue;\n    }\n    state.eventIds.add(event.id);\n    writeLine(io.stdout, `[event:${event.eventType}] ${describeExecutionEvent(event.details, event.eventType)}`);\n  }\n\n  for (const worker of runWorkers) {\n    const text = displayWorkerText(worker, agentByWorkerId.get(worker.id) ?? null);\n    if (!text || state.workerTextById.get(worker.id) === text) {\n      continue;\n    }\n    state.workerTextById.set(worker.id, text);\n    writeLine(io.stdout, `[worker:${worker.id}] ${text}`);\n  }\n\n  if (run && (run.status === \"done\" || run.status === \"failed\") && !state.printedTerminal) {\n    state.printedTerminal = true;\n    writeLine(io.stdout, `[run:${run.status}] ${run.lastError || run.title || run.id}`);\n  }\n\n  return {\n    run,\n    workers: runWorkers,\n  };\n}\n\nfunction shouldContinueWatching(snapshot: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof printRunUpdates>>) {\n  const run = snapshot.run;\n  if (!run) {\n    return false;\n  }\n  if (run.status === \"done\" || run.status === \"failed\") {\n    return false;\n  }\n  // Supervisor-driven runs (implementation mode, past any planning phase) keep\n  // streaming until terminal. Planning-phase Omni runs and direct/planning runs\n  // watch their single worker instead.\n  if (run.mode === \"implementation\" && run.phase !== \"planning\") {\n    return true;\n  }\n\n  return snapshot.workers.some((worker) => [\"starting\", \"working\", \"running\"].includes(worker.status));\n}\n\nasync function watchRun(runId: string, io: OmniCliIo) {\n  const state: WatchState = {\n    messageIds: new Set(),\n    eventIds: new Set(),\n    workerTextById: new Map(),\n    printedTerminal: false,\n  };\n\n  while (true) {\n    const snapshot = await printRunUpdates(runId, state, io);\n    if (!shouldContinueWatching(snapshot)) {\n      return;\n    }\n    await waitForEventStreamNotification(1_000);\n  }\n}\n\nexport async function runOmniCli(argv: string[], io: OmniCliIo = process) {\n  let options: OmniCliOptions;\n  try {\n    options = parseOmniCliArgs(argv);\n  } catch (error) {\n    if (error instanceof OmniCliUsageError) {\n      if (error.message) {\n        writeLine(io.stderr, `Error: ${error.message}`);\n        writeLine(io.stderr);\n      }\n      writeLine(error.message ? io.stderr : io.stdout, omniCliUsage());\n      return error.message ? 1 : 0;\n    }\n    throw error;\n  }\n\n  const runtime = createOmniRuntime({\n    surface: \"cli\",\n    label: \"Omni CLI\",\n    hooks: {\n      onStart: ensureSupervisorRuntimeStarted,\n    },\n  });\n\n  await runtime.start();\n\n  try {\n    const created = await createConversation({\n      mode: options.mode,\n      command: options.command,\n      projectPath: options.projectPath,\n      preferredWorkerType: options.preferredWorkerType,\n      preferredWorkerModel: options.preferredWorkerModel,\n      preferredWorkerEffort: options.preferredWorkerEffort,\n      allowedWorkerTypes: options.allowedWorkerTypes,\n    });\n\n    if (options.json) {\n      writeLine(io.stdout, JSON.stringify(created, null, 2));\n    } else {\n      writeLine(io.stdout, `Started ${created.mode} conversation ${created.runId}`);\n      writeLine(io.stdout, `Plan ${created.planId}`);\n    }\n\n    if (options.watch) {\n      await watchRun(created.runId, io);\n    }\n\n    return 0;\n  } finally {\n    await runtime.stop(\"shutdown\");\n  }\n}\n\n===== password =[REDACTED] node\nimport crypto from \"node:crypto\";\nimport fs from \"node:fs\";\nimport path from \"node:path\";\nimport process from \"node:process\";\nimport { pathToFileURL } from \"node:url\";\nimport { hash, verify } from \"@node-rs/argon2\";\nimport { escapeEnvValueForDotenv } from \"./setup-auth.mjs\";\n\nconst AUTH_HASH_KEY = \"OMNIHARNESS_AUTH_PASSWORD_HASH\";\nconst AUTH_PASSWORD_KEY = \"OMNIHARNESS_AUTH_PASSWORD\";\nconst ARGON_OPTIONS = {\n  algorithm: 2,\n  memoryCost: 19_456,\n  timeCost: 2,\n  parallelism: 1,\n  outputLen: 32,\n};\n\nfunction normalizeEnvValue(value) {\n  let normalized = String(value ?? \"hash\"\n    : processEnv.password || envFile.password\n      ? \"password\"\n      : \"none\";\n  const revealablePassword = effectiveSource === \"password\"\n    ? processEnv.password ?? envFile.password\n    : null;\n\n  return {\n    configured: effectiveSource !== \"none\",\n    effectiveSource,\n    revealablePassword,\n    envFile,\n    processEnv,\n  };\n}\n\nexport function formatAuthStatus(summary) {\n  if (!summary.configured) {\n    return \"OmniHarness auth is not configured. Run `pnpm auth:password set` to create a password.\\n\";\n  }\n\n  if (summary.effectiveSource === \"hash\") {\n    return [\n      \"OmniHarness auth is configured.\",\n      \"Effective source: OMNIHARNESS_AUTH_PASSWORD_HASH (hash-only; original password cannot be shown).\",\n      \"Run `pnpm auth:password verify` to test a password, or `pnpm auth:password set` to replace it.\",\n      \"\",\n    ].join(\"\\n\");\n  }\n\n  return [\n    \"OmniHarness auth is configured.\",\n    \"Effective source: OMNIHARNESS_AUTH_PASSWORD.\",\n    `Current password: [REDACTED]    \"Run `pnpm auth:password set` to replace it with a stored hash.\",\n    \"\",\n  ].join(\"\\n\");\n}\n\nexport async function updateEnvTextWithPassword(envText, password) {\n  if (!String(password ?? \"\")) {\n    throw new Error(\"Password must not be empty.\");\n  }\n\n  const passwordHash = await hash(String(password), ARGON_OPTIONS);\n  const escapedHash = escapeEnvValueForDotenv(passwordHash);\n  const keptText = envText\n    .split(/\\r?\\n/g)\n    .filter((line) => !isActiveAuthLine(line))\n    .join(\"\\n\")\n    .replace(/\\n+$/g, \"\");\n  const prefix = keptText ? `${keptText}\\n\\n` : \"\";\n\n  return {\n    envText: `${prefix}# OmniHarness web login password. Managed by pnpm auth:password.\\n${AUTH_HASH_KEY}=${escapedHash}\\n`,\n    passwordHash,\n  };\n}\n\nexport async function verifyPasswordAgainstEnvText(envText, password, env = {}) {\n  const summary = inspectAuthConfig(envText, env);\n  const configuredHash = summary.processEnv.hash ?? summary.envFile.hash;\n  if (configuredHash) {\n    return verify(configuredHash, String(password), Buffer.from(configuredPassword, \"utf8\");\n  const right = Buffer.from(String(password), \"utf8\");\n  return left.length === right.length && crypto.timingSafeEqual(left, right);\n}\n\nfunction usage() {\n  return [\n    \"Usage:\",\n    \"  pnpm auth:password status [--env-file .env]\",\n    \"  pnpm auth:password verify [password] [--env-file .env]\",\n    \"  pnpm auth:password set [password] [--env-file .env]\",\n    \"\",\n    \"If password is omitted for `set` or `verify`, the command prompts in a TTY.\",\n    \"\",\n  ].join(\"\\n\");\n}\n\nfunction parseArgs(argv) {\n  const options = {\n    command: \"status\",\n    envFile: path.resolve(\".env\"),\n    password: null,\n  };\n  const positional = [];\n\n  for (let index = 0; index < argv.length; index += 1) {\n    const arg = argv[index];\n    if (arg === \"--env-file\") {\n      const next = argv[index + 1];\n      if (!next) {\n        throw new Error(\"--env-file requires a path.\");\n      }\n      options.envFile = path.resolve(next);\n      index += 1;\n      continue;\n    }\n    if (arg === \"-h\" || arg === \"--help\") {\n      options.command = \"help\";\n      continue;\n    }\n    positional.push(arg);\n  }\n\n  if (positional[0]) {\n    options.command = positional[0];\n  }\n  if (positional[1]) {\n    options.password = [REDACTED]  }\n  if (positional.length > 2) {\n    throw new Error(\"Too many positional arguments.\");\n  }\n\n  if (options.command === \"show\") {\n    options.command = \"status\";\n  }\n\n  return options;\n}\n\nasync function promptHidden(message) {\n  if (!process.stdin.isTTY || !process.stdout.isTTY) {\n    throw new Error(\"Password argument is required when stdin is not a TTY.\");\n  }\n\n  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {\n    const process.stdin.resume();\n    process.stdin.on(\"data\", onData);\n  });\n}\n\nfunction readEnvFile(envFile) {\n  try {\n    return fs.readFileSync(envFile, \"utf8\");\n  } catch (error) {\n    if (error?.code === \"ENOENT\") {\n      return \"\";\n    }\n    throw error;\n  }\n}\n\nasync function main() {\n  const options = parseArgs(process.argv.slice(2));\n  if (options.command === \"help\") process.stdout.write(formatAuthStatus(inspectAuthConfig(envText, process.env)));\n    return;\n  }\n\n  if (options.command === \"verify\") {\n    const password = [REDACTED] ?? await process.stdout.write(`Updated ${options.envFile} with ${AUTH_HASH_KEY}.\\n`);\n    process.stdout.write(\"Restart OmniHarness for the new password to take effect.\\n\");\n    return;\n  }\n\n  throw new Error(`Unknown command: ${options.command}\\n\\n${usage()}`);\n}\n\nif (process.argv[1] && import.meta.url === pathToFileURL(process.argv[1]).href) {\n  main().catch((error) => {\n <!-- codex-event:{"kind":"progress","timestamp":"2026-07-31T02:07:50.024Z","phase":"commentary"} -->
## Codex progress · 2026-07-31T02:07:50.024Z

The session API already has a useful base, but two important guarantees are missing: the 50-session cap and immediate invalidation of cached requests and already-open streams. I’m adding those as one shared revocation mechanism so API calls and both stream types behave consistently.

+import { insertAuthEvent } from "@/server/auth/audit";

+
+function methodNotAllowed(allow: string) {
+  return Response.json({
+    error: { code: "method_not_allowed", message: "Method not allowed." },
+  }, {
+    status: 405,
+    headers: { allow },
+  });
+}
+
+async function readBody(request: Request) {
+  try {
+    const body = await request.json();
+    return body && typeof body === "object"
+      ? body as Record<string, unknown>
+      : {};
+  } catch {
+    return {};
+  }
+}
+
+export const handleRunnerSettingsRequest: OmniHttpHandler = async (request) => {
+  if (request.method !== "PATCH") {
+    return methodNotAllowed("PATCH");
+  }
+  const auth = await requireApiSession(request, {
+    source: "Runner",
+    action: "Rename runner",
+    enforceSameOrigin: true,
+  });
+  if (auth.response) {
+    return auth.response;
+  }
+
+  const body = await readBody(request);
+  try {
+    const previous = await ensureRunnerIdentity();
+    const next = await renameRunner(typeof body.name === "string" ? body.name : "");
+    await insertAuthEvent({
+      eventType: "runner.renamed",
+      sessionId: auth.session?.id ?? null,
+      details: {
+        runnerInstanceId: next.runnerInstanceId,
+        previousName: previous.name,
+        name: next.name,
+      },
+    });
+    emitNamedEvent({
+      kind: "runner.renamed",
+      runnerInstanceId: next.runnerInstanceId,
+      previousName: previous.name,
+      name: next.name,
+    });
+    return Response.json({ runner: next });
+  } catch (error) {
+    return Response.json({
+      error: {
+        code: "runner.invalid_name",
+        message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),
+      },
+    }, { status: 400 });
+  }
+};
+
+export const handleRunnerRekeyRequest: OmniHttpHandler = async (request) => {
+  if (request.method !== "POST") {
+    return methodNotAllowed("POST");
+  }
+  const auth = await requireApiSession(request, {
+    source: "Runner",
+    action: "Rekey runner",
+    enforceSameOrigin: true,
+  });
+  if (auth.response) {
+    return auth.response;
+  }

+  runtimeBootstrapRoute,
+} from "@/../tests/helpers/runtime-routes";
+
+function cookieRequest(url: string, method: string, token: string, body: unknown) {
+  return new Request(url, {
+    method,
+    headers: {
+      cookie: `${AUTH_SESSION_COOKIE}=${token}`,
+      origin: "http://localhost",
+      "content-type": "application/json",
+    },
+    body: JSON.stringify(body),
+  });
+}
+
+describe("runner administration routes", () => {
+  beforeEach(async () => {
+    process.env.OMNIHARNESS_AUTH_PASSWORD = "test-password";
+    await db.delete(authEvents);
+    await db.delete(authSessions);
+    __resetNamedEventsForTests();
+    await renameRunner("OmniHarness Runner");
+  });
+
+  it("renames the runner and propagates it through bootstrap with audit and named events", async () => {
+    const session = await createAuthSession({
+      authMethod: "password_login",
+      label: "Admin",
+    });
+    const cursor = getEventCursor();
+    const response = await runnerSettingsRoute(cookieRequest(
+      "http://localhost/api/runner",
+      "PATCH",
+      session.tokenValue,
+      { name: "Studio runner" },
+    ));
+
+    expect(response.status).toBe(200);
+    const bootstrap = await runtimeBootstrapRoute(new Request("http://localhost/api/runtime/bootstrap"));
+    await expect(bootstrap.json()).resolves.toEqual(expect.objectContaining({
+      runner: expect.objectContaining({ name: "Studio runner" }),
+    }));
+    expect((await db.select().from(authEvents)).some((event) => event.eventType === "runner.renamed")).toBe(true);
+    expect(getNamedEventsSince(cursor).events.map((entry) => entry.event)).toContainEqual(
+      expect.objectContaining({ kind: "runner.renamed", name: "Studio runner" }),
+    );
+  });
+
+  it("rekeys the runner and reports both old and new identities", async () => {
+    const session = await createAuthSession({
+      authMethod: "password_login",
+      label: "Admin",
+    });
+    const before = await ensureRunnerIdentity();
+    const cursor = getEventCursor();

+      "http://localhost/api/runner/rekey",
+      "POST",
+      session.tokenValue,
+      {},
+    ));
+
+    expect(response.status).toBe(200);
+    const body = await response.json();
+    expect(body.previousRunnerInstanceId).toBe(before.runnerInstanceId);

+function normalizeRunnerUrl(value: string) {
+  const url = new URL(value);
+  const loopback = ["localhost", "127.0.0.1", "::1"].includes(url.hostname);
+  if (url.protocol !== "https:" && !(url.protocol === "http:" && loopback)) {
+    throw new Error("Remote runners require HTTPS; loopback HTTP is allowed for local development.");
+  }
+  url.pathname = "/";
+  url.search = "";
+  url.hash = "";
+  return url;
+}
+
+async function readError(response: Response) {
+  const body = await response.json().catch(() => null) as {
+    error?: { message?: string } | string;
+  } | null;
+  if (typeof body?.error === "string") {
+    return body.error;
+  }
+  return body?.error?.message || `Runner request failed with HTTP ${response.status}.`;
+}

+export async function createRemoteConversation(input: {
+  runnerUrl: string;

+import path from "node:path";

+function readFlagValue(argv: string[], index: number, flag: string) {
+  const value = argv[index + 1]?.trim();
+  if (!value || value.startsWith("--")) {
+    throw new Error(`${flag} requires a value.`);
+  }
+  return value;
+}
+
+export function parseRunnerAdminArgs(argv: string[]) {
+  let runnerUrl: string | null = null;
+  let tokenFile: string | null = null;
+  let tokenStdin = false;
+  let legacyToken: string | null = null;
+  let confirmRunnerInstanceId: string | null = null;
+  for (let index = 0; index < argv.length; index += 1) {
+    const arg = argv[index];
+    if (arg === "--runner") {
+      runnerUrl = readFlagValue(argv, index, arg);
+      index += 1;
+    } else if (arg === "--token-file") {
+      tokenFile = path.resolve(readFlagValue(argv, index, arg));
+      index += 1;
+    } else if (arg === "--token-stdin") {
+      tokenStdin = true;
+    } else if (arg === "--token") {
+      legacyToken = readFlagValue(argv, index, arg);
+      index += 1;
+    } else if (arg === "--confirm-identity") {
+      confirmRunnerInstanceId = readFlagValue(argv, index, arg);
+      index += 1;
+    } else {
+      throw new Error(`Unknown runner administration option: ${arg}`);
+    }
+  }
+  if (!runnerUrl) {
+    throw new Error("omni runner rekey requires --runner <url>.");
+  }
+  return {
+    runnerUrl,
+    tokenFile,
+    tokenStdin,
+    legacyToken,
+    confirmRunnerInstanceId,
+  };
+}
+
+export async function runRunnerRekeyCommand(
+  argv: string[],
+  options: {
+    env?: NodeJS.ProcessEnv;
+    fetchImpl?: typeof fetch;
+    readStdin?: () => Promise<string>;
+  } = {},
+) {
+  const parsed = parseRunnerAdminArgs(argv);
+  const credential = await resolveRemoteRunnerToken({

+    tokenFile: parsed.tokenFile,
+    tokenStdin: parsed.tokenStdin,
+    legacyToken: parsed.legacyToken,
+    readStdin: options.readStdin,
+  });
+  const url = new URL("/api/runner/rekey", parsed.runnerUrl);

The client never treats two simultaneously reachable\nendpoints with one identity as interchangeable — it flags the conflict.\n\nClient-side profile:\n\n```ts\ntype RunnerProfile = {\n  id: string;                 // client uuid for list keys only — NOT identity\n  runnerInstanceId?: string;  // learned at first successful login/connect\n  label: string; baseUrl: string;\n  authTransport: \"cookie\" | \"bearer\";\n  credentialRef?: string;     // token lives behind the platform credential store\n  schemaVersion: 1;\n  createdAt: string; lastConnectedAt?: string;\n};\n```\n\n- Identity rules: after login, the profile pins `runnerInstanceId`. +export class BoundedRunnerPreviewCache<T> {
+  private readonly entries = new Map<string, T>();
+  constructor(private readonly maximumEntries = 100) {}
+
+  get(key: string) {
+    const value = this.entries.get(key);
+    if (value === undefined) return undefined;
+    this.entries.delete(key);
+    this.entries.set(key, value);
+    return value;
+  }
+
+  set(key: string, value: T) {
+    this.entries.delete(key);
+    this.entries.set(key, value);
+    while (this.entries.size > this.maximumEntries) {
+      const oldest = this.entries.keys().next().value;
+      if (oldest === undefined) break;
+      this.entries.delete(oldest);
+    }
+  }
+
+  clear() {
+    this.entries.clear();
+  }
+
+  get size() {
+    return this.entries.size;
+  }

+import type { RunnerProfile } from "./RunnerProfile";
+
+const RunnerRegistryContext = createContext<RunnerRegistry | null>(null);
+const fallbackQueryClient = new QueryClient();
+
+function adaptRuntime(runtime: RuntimeAPIs): RunnerConnectionRuntime {
+  return {
+    bootstrap: runtime.bootstrap,
+    events: {
+      snapshot: runtime.events.snapshot,
+      open(input, handlers) {
+        return runtime.events.open(input, {
+          onOpen: handlers.onOpen,
+          onEvent: handlers.onEvent ?? (() => {}),
+          onError: handlers.onError,
+        });
+      },
+    },
+    terminals: {
+      openStream(input, handlers) {
+        return runtime.terminals.openStream(input, {
+          onOpen: handlers.onOpen,
+          onEvent: handlers.onEvent ?? (() => {}),
+          onError: handlers.onError,
+        });
+      },
+    },
+  };
+}
+
+export function createWebRunnerRuntimeFactory(
+  credentialStore: RunnerCredentialStore,
+) {
+  return async (profile: RunnerProfile): Promise<RunnerConnectionRuntime> => {
+    if (profile.authTransport === "cookie") {
+      return adaptRuntime(createWebRuntimeAPIs({
+        baseUrl: profile.isSameOrigin ? "" : profile.baseUrl,
+      }));
+    }
+    if (!profile.credentialRef) {
+      throw {
+        code: "runtime.http_401",
+        message: "Runner authorization is required.",
+      };
+    }
+    return credentialStore.useCredential(
+      profile.credentialRef,
+      {
+        origin: profile.baseUrl,
+        runnerInstanceId: profile.runnerInstanceId,
+      },
+      (token) => adaptRuntime(createWebRuntimeAPIs({
+        baseUrl: profile.baseUrl,
+        bearerToken: token,
+      })),
+    );
+  };
+}
+
+export function createDefaultRunnerRegistry() {
+  const credentials = new WebRunnerCredentialStore();
+  const profiles = new RunnerProfileStore({
+    credentialStore: credentials,
+  });
+  const runtimeFactory = createWebRunnerRuntimeFactory(credentials);
+  const registry = new RunnerRegistry({
+    profileStore: profiles,
+    connectionFactory: (profile) => new RunnerConnection({
+      profile,
+      persistence: profiles,
+      runtimeFactory,
+    }),
+  });
+  return { registry, profiles, credentials };
+}
+
+function useRegistrySnapshot(registry: RunnerRegistry) {
+  return useSyncExternalStore(
+    (listener) => registry.subscribe(listener),
+    () => registry.getSnapshot(),
+    () => registry.getInitialSnapshot(),
+  );
+}
+
+export function RunnerRegistryProvider({
+  registry,
+  profileStore,
+  children,
+}: PropsWithChildren<{
+  registry: RunnerRegistry;
+  profileStore?: RunnerProfileStore;
+}>) {
+  const snapshot = useRegistrySnapshot(registry);
+  const activeConnection = snapshot.activeRunnerId
+    ? registry.getConnection(snapshot.activeRunnerId)
+    : null;
+  const queryClient = activeConnection?.getQueryClient() ?? fallbackQueryClient;
+
+  useEffect(() => {
+    let cancelled = false;
+    void (async () => {
+      if (profileStore) {
+        await profileStore.hydrate();
+      }
+      if (!cancelled) {
+        await registry.start();
+      }
+    })();
+    return () => {
+      cancelled = true;
+      registry.stop();
+    };
+  }, [profileStore, registry]);
+
+  return (
+    <RunnerRegistryContext.Provider value={registry}>
+      <QueryClientProvider client={queryClient}>
+        {children}
+      </QueryClientProvider>
+    </RunnerRegistryContext.Provider>
+  );
+}
+
+export function useRunnerRegistry() {
+  const registry = useContext(RunnerRegistryContext);
+  if (!registry) {
+    throw new Error("Runner registry is not available.");
+  }
+  return registry;
+}
+
+export function useRunnerConnections() {
+  const registry = useRunnerRegistry();
+  return useRegistrySnapshot(registry).connections;
+}
+
+export function useActiveRunnerConnection() {
+  const registry = useRunnerRegistry();
+  const snapshot = useRegistrySnapshot(registry);
+  return useMemo(

+      ? registry.getConnection(snapshot.activeRunnerId)

Examples:\n   - full dashboard with sidebar, charts, and table: `npx shadcn add dashboard-01`\n   - collapsible sidebar shell: `npx shadcn add sidebar-07`\n   - submenu sidebar shell: `npx shadcn add sidebar-03`\n   - login page: `npx shadcn add login-03` or `npx shadcn add login-04`\n6. Adapt the cloned block to the product: remove irrelevant demo content, wire real data and navigation, rename components if needed, and keep shadcn components as the base controls.\n7. Verify the finished UI in the running app, including desktop and mobile layouts.\n\n## Selection Standard\n\nChoose based on structure first, visual details second. A block with the right navigation, density, table/chart/form shape, and responsive behavior is a better starting point than a prettier block with the wrong information architecture.\n\nIf there is no exact block, install or copy the nearest block and reduce it. This ensures subsequent commands in this session use the freshly-written PRODUCT.md, not a stale earlier version.\n\nIf teach was invoked as a blocker by another impeccable command (e.g. the user ran `$impeccable polish` with no PRODUCT.md), resume that original task now with the fresh context.\n\nOptionally ask the user directly to clarify what you cannot infer. whether they'd like a brief summary of PRODUCT.md appended to AGENTS.md for easier agent reference. If yes, append a short **Design Context** pointer section there.\n# Product register\n\nWhen design SERVES the product: app UIs, admin dashboards, settings panels, data tables, tools, authenticated surfaces, anything where the user is in a task.\n\n## The product slop test\n\nNot \"would someone say AI made this\" — familiarity is often a feature here. The test is: would a user fluent in the category's best tools (Linear, Figma, Notion, Raycast, Stripe come to mind) sit down and trust this interface, or pause at every subtly-off component?\n\nProduct UI's failure mode isn't flatness, it's strangeness without purpose: over-decorated buttons, mismatched form controls, gratuitous motion, display fonts where labels should be, invented affordances for standard tasks. The bar is earned familiarity. The tool should disappear into the task.\n\n## Typography\n\n- **System fonts are legitimate.** `-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, \"Segoe UI\", system-ui, sans-serif` gives you native feel on every platform. Inter is the common cross-platform default for a reason.\n- **One family is often right.** Product UIs don't need display/body pairing. A well-tuned sans carries headings, buttons, labels, body, data.\n- **Fixed rem scale, not fluid.** Clamp-sized headings don't serve product UI. Users view at consistent DPI, and a fluid h1 that shrinks in a sidebar looks worse, not better.\n- **Tighter scale ratio.** 1.125–1.2 between steps is typical. More type elements here than on brand surfaces; exaggerated contrast creates noise.\n- **Line length still applies for prose** (65–75ch). Data and compact UI can run denser — tables at 120ch+ are fine.\n\n## Color\n\nProduct defaults to Restrained. A single surface can earn Committed — a dashboard where one category color carries a report, an onboarding flow with a drenched welcome screen — but Restrained is the floor.\n\n- State-rich semantic vocabulary: hover, focus, active, disabled, selected, loading, error, warning, success, info. Standardize these.\n- Accent color used for primary actions, current selection, and state indicators only — not decoration.\n- A second neutral layer for sidebars, toolbars, and panels (slightly cooler or warmer than the content surface).\n\n## Layout\n\n- Predictable grids. Consistency IS an affordance — users navigate faster when the structure is expected.\n- Familiar patterns are features. Standard navigation (top bar, side nav), breadcrumbs, tabs, and form layouts have established user expectations. Don't reinvent for flavor.\n- Responsive behavior is structural (collapse sidebar, responsive table, breakpoint-driven columns), not fluid typography.\n\n## Components\n\nEvery interactive component has: default, hover, focus, active, disabled, loading, error. Don't ship with half of these.\n\n- Skeleton states for loading, not spinners in the middle of content.\n- Empty states that teach the interface, not \"nothing here.\"\n- Consistent affordances across the surface. Same button shape. Same form-control vocabulary. Same icon style.\n\n## Motion\n\n- 150–250 ms on most transitions. Users are in flow — don't make them wait for choreography.\n- Motion conveys state, not decoration. State change, feedback, loading, reveal — nothing else.\n- No orchestrated page-load sequences. Product loads into a task; users don't want to watch it load.\n\n## Product bans (on top of the shared absolute bans)\n\n- Decorative motion that doesn't convey state.\n- Inconsistent component vocabulary across screens. If the \"save\" button looks different in two places, one is wrong.\n- Display fonts in UI labels, buttons, data.\n- Reinventing standard affordances for flavor (custom scrollbars, weird form controls, non-standard modals).\n- Heavy color or full-saturation accents on inactive states.\n\n## Product permissions\n\nProduct can afford things brand surfaces can't.\n\n- System fonts and familiar sans defaults (Inter, SF Pro, system-ui stacks).\n- Standard navigation patterns: top bar + side nav, breadcrumbs, tabs, command palettes.\n- Density. Tables with many rows, panels with many labels, dense information when users need it.\n- Consistency over surprise. The same visual vocabulary screen to screen is a virtue; delight is saved for moments, not pages.\n"

## Tool call: apply_patch · 2026-07-31T02:33:20.287Z

```json
*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /Users/masterman/NLP/omniharness/PRODUCT.md
+# Product
+
+## Register
+
+product
+
+## Users
+
+Software developers and technical leads supervising several coding agents across local, remote, desktop, editor, and mobile surfaces. They work in long-running implementation and debugging sessions where clear state, rapid switching, durable recovery, and trustworthy control matter more than decorative presentation.
+
+## Product Purpose
+
+OmniHarness is a durable control plane for starting, observing, steering, and recovering ACP-backed coding-agent work. Success means a user can understand what every runner and worker is doing, take the next safe action quickly, move between devices and servers without losing context, and trust that failures, credentials, and recovery states are represented honestly.
+
+## Brand Personality
+
+Calm, capable, direct. The interface should feel like a precise professional tool with a human voice: dense when the work demands it, quiet when it does not, and explicit about uncertainty or failure.
+
+## Anti-references
+
+- Generic analytics dashboards built from interchangeable metric cards.
+- Sci-fi command centers with neon decoration, fake telemetry, or gratuitous motion.
+- Chat interfaces that hide execution state and recovery controls behind conversational chrome.
+- Consumer onboarding that stretches a simple connection task into a promotional sequence.
+- Interfaces that make remote, offline, authentication, or identity failures look like temporary loading.
+
+## Design Principles
+
+1. Show authority and scope. Every action, status, notification, and cache belongs visibly to one runner and one conversation.
+2. Keep supervision fast. Frequent actions remain close to the active work, with familiar controls and strong keyboard behavior.
+3. Make failure honest and recoverable. Name the affected runner, explain the state, and offer the smallest safe next action.
+4. Preserve context across time and surfaces. Switching, reconnecting, and returning later should not erase drafts, cursors, or the user’s mental model.
+5. Let the work dominate. Navigation and status remain legible but visually restrained around agent output, terminal content, and decisions.
+
+## Accessibility & Inclusion
+
+Target WCAG 2.2 AA. All flows must support keyboard navigation, visible focus, screen readers, zoom and narrow layouts, live language changes, reduced motion, and status communication that does not rely on color alone.
*** End Patch

```
